# testing_x_terraform_custom_default (Resource)

XTerraformCustomDefault Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_terraform_custom_default" "my_xterraformcustomdefault" {
  bool    = true
  float32 = 7.89
  float64 = 5.31
  int32   = 1
  int64   = 1
  integer = 3
  list_string = [
    "..."
  ]
  map_string = {
    key = "value"
  }
  number = 5.12
  object = {
    object_string = "...my_object_string..."
  }
  object_with_underlying_custom_defaults = {
    bool    = false
    float32 = 3.48
    float64 = 4.18
    int32   = 6
    int64   = 8
    integer = 9
    list_string = [
      "..."
    ]
    map_string = {
      key = "value"
    }
    number = 5.75
    object = {
      object_string = "...my_object_string..."
    }
    set_string = [
      "..."
    ]
    string = "...my_string..."
  }
  set_string = [
    "..."
  ]
  string = "...my_string..."
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_terraform_custom_default.my_testing_x_terraform_custom_default
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_terraform_custom_default.my_testing_x_terraform_custom_default "..."
```
